corrections.replace: the fifteenth magical conclusion, the first of the series to name Kabbalah (farmer1998:25288; copenhaver2019:17366-17369).

Here Kabbalah names the Jewish tradition of esoteric interpretation of the Law that Pico, in the Oration and Apology, took to have been revealed to Moses and handed down orally, together with the operations based on it (wirszubski1989:6328-6334).
Copenhaver grounds it in a hierarchy of domains: practical Kabbalah transcends the natural magic that can achieve nothing without it, according to this thesis (copenhaver2019:18094-18097).
